text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To lose this badly...!! How... Why did 
this happen...!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I swore I'd become a big sister they
could 
be proud of...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina was deeply in shock. Yet, the 
flame of fighting spirit still burned in 
her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, indeed. I will make sure to grow 
from this defeat.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
So that my back is the goal they strive
to 
reach—...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Of course! If I keep my head down, I'll 
only disappoint those girls.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's enough blaming myself. I will pick 
myself back up, as many times as it takes.
